hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom-curve swap between ETH and phiEth, a wrapped ETH token. In beforeSwap, the hook takes the input from the pool manager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, and settles the output, returning a delta that fully bypasses the standard AMM curve. Liquidity additions to the pool are permanently blocked.
